## Decision

Removing spec-guard GENERATED_EXEMPT is accepted as a recorded D-6 exception: writes under doc/specs/_generated/ now emit spec-guard: WARN (fail-open, permitted) in sessions without a run ledger, where they were previously silent. No deny path changed; spec-guard has no deny branch before or after. doc/specs/_generated/ still exists and is still written by spec.mjs build.

## Rationale

The branch was reachable (spec build still writes _generated/), so this is an observable output change, not dead-code removal; but it moves no enforcement outcome and opens no legacy/gw seam (no src/gw/hook/spec-guard.ts, spec-guard absent from parity corpus). Blast radius is one stderr WARN per write in no-ledger sessions.

## Alternatives Considered

- restore GENERATED_EXEMPT passthrough
